d.title: Precure All Stars Movie DX: Minna Tomodachi☆Kiseki no Zenin Daishuugou!
d.jp: 映画 プリキュアオールスターズDX みんなともだちっ☆奇跡の全員大集合!
syn: Eiga Precure All Stars DX: Minna Tomodachi - Kiseki no Zenin Daishuugou!
d.synopsis: Love, Miki and Inori are on their way to a dance contest, but get lost on their way to Minato Mirai. Still looking for their way, they are attacked by a monster. When the three Fresh Precure girls start to fight it, other Precures show up to support them. They all have to combine their powers to win against this mighty enemy.
